plugins.name: gh-review-loop
plugins.description: Opinionated AI code-review PR loop for solo builders and small teams using Claude Code. Drives Codex or Gemini Code Assist: reads real review-thread state, normalizes each reviewer's priority scale, supports severity filtering, stops at a configurable cycle cap, auto-resolves stale and addressed-by-reply threads, and can post a live sticky-receipt comment for background visibility.
